title: Creative clubbing institution elrow comes to Motion this December
content:
16th July 2015


Creative clubbing institution elrow, bring their renowned party spectacle to the UK for a series of three special daytime events across the summer and Bristol’s legendary Motion is among the lucky blighters to be selected for a landing spot!

Using elaborate set design, troops of performers, an inventory of confetti cannons and tons of zany spanish flair, elrow create a dazzling, immersive experience that sets them amongst the leading global innovators of party production. Equally repute for their music offering, elrow’s accomplished residents are joined each night by a secret headline act, with previous guests including the likes of Seth Troxler, The Martinez Brothers, Tiga and Marco Carola.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=EXTxBFksb4E

Brainchild of the Arnau family, elrow is the newest project from a dynasty of elite Spanish promoters, who have forged a legacy over three generations that counts Monegros Desert Festival and Florida 135 amongst their accolades. Their UK forage sees them teaming up with leading industry creatives, Jo Vidler of Secret Productions and Bristol clubbing mecca Motion for something that promises to be truly spectacular.


Elrow will also host a special winter event at Bristol’s Motion as part of their In:Motion series, the 12 hour event will take place on Saturday the 5th December.

Jungle Sambodromo was born on a bright Sunday morning close to the airport in Barcelona. As part of the weekly Elrow parties we decided to add some extra spice, once a month we completely transformed the club into an immersive themed environment. Now in 2015 we are taking these themes on the road, typical food stalls, fruit areas and juices are all part of the content for this theme, alongside the usual antics of an Elrow show, expect stiltwalkers, confetti, confetti and more confetti!
Elrow Creators

The UK shows will sustain the music, colour and happiness that make up the essential elements of elrow’s DNA, maintaining a focus on having fun and creating a unique clubbing experience for everyone involved, regardless of city, country or time of day.

To get tickets or find out more just click here.

The show at Village Underground sold out a week in advance of the event so please purchase tickets early to avoid any disappointment.

Kevin McGough
